QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] The Shadowdealers' Strength
QuestInfo.0: You meet up with that grumpy Shadowdealers you ran into in Savage Terminal. They don't seem to like you all that much.
QuestInfo.1: You've got some time to speak with Cadena. Maybe you'll get some useful information.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you've spoken with Cadena, you're ready to meet the next hero at Eurenth's Hut.

default.0: Don't bother trying to keep any secrets. I'll beat the truth out of you if I have to.
